verdicts.reason: Both break the original: the orange tint covers only part of the canvas, so the raw photo shows on the left. The white frame is shrunk into an empty set of boxes on the left with nothing inside it. 'Richmond High School Theatre Presents' is squeezed into a narrow column of one or two words per line. The play icon is oversized and competes with the headline. In A, the 'Pygmalion' headline runs across the edge where the photo meets the orange panel, so part of it sits on the busy image, and the tickets text is jammed against the bottom edge. B keeps the headline inside the orange panel and wraps the credit and tickets lines more cleanly, so it is the less bad of the two.
